title: Hatsune Miku — Happy Anniversary!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And hello to everybody watching the stream! I hope you guys can see us okay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, we're getting a ton of comments!
Yes, it looks like they see us just fine!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO, look. Some people are saying that they saw the trailer you made.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? Did anyone in the audience also happen to see it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! So many people are saying they saw it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Which means they all saw how adorable Miku was when she seemed so embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, she was way too cute!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know right?! Miku got a little mad and said, “Why'd you leave it in?!” But there was no way I was taking that part out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're all going to see an even cuter and more wonderful Miku than what you saw in that video! Get ready!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, I believe it's time for our star to make her entrance.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right! Everyone, let's count down together! Five seconds!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
It's me, Hatsune Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all for joining us for my anniversary show! And a special thanks to all those watching the stream!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to sing lots and lots of songs for you today to show just how much I appreciate all of you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That was a nice first song, Miku!
You sound great right out of the gates!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I may've gotten a bit ahead of myself after seeing how many people I'd be singing in front of♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, I'm going to hold onto this feeling and keep showing my appreciation for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, you're not the only ones I want to thank today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As a way of showing my appreciation, I came up with songs for each of you that I'm hoping you'll sing with me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Of course we'll sing with you!
Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'd be more than happy to do so, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
First, Luka!
If you'll join me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Alright, start the music♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We're just getting started!
Everyone, together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That just leaves me. Ready, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your energy felt so incredible, everyone! I had a lot of fun singing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I take it you're also having fun?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This next song will be our last, so let's keep this energy up until the end!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, stop!
There's something we need to do before you sing your last song!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Something you need to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Just as you wanted to show your appreciation for us, Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's something we'd all like to tell you. Would you mind listening for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Miku!
And thank you for always being such a great friend♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really love singing, playing and talking with you! So I hope we get to be friends forever!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Miku! Thank you for always being there to help Rin and I make up whenever we fight. We really appreciate what you do for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You even correctly point out who's to blame, which makes it easier for the person at fault to apologize to the other.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I feel like we can get into fights without really worrying since we know you're gonna be there for us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: FYI, I don't fight because I want to! If anything, we should be more careful in the future.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. You really may be the best out of all of us at bringing peace between them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And singing is no different. It's important to think about how the person you're singing to feels...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're such a wonderful person, Miku. So, happy anniversary, and I hope you keep being the beautiful soul you already are!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Miku. MEIKO sort of already beat me to it, but I also think it's really wonderful how thoughtful you are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even for today's show, you danced and sang to show how much you appreciate everybody here, even though it was really supposed to be about you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe that's why we all love you so much, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course, that also includes me♪
So, I hope you'll keep being an amazing person.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Miku.
Getting to sing on the same stage as you during such a special occasion fills my heart with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you made it clear through your performances just how much you appreciate all of us here. I'm really at a loss for words...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
KAITO...?
Hold on. Are you crying?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm not!
I just... I can't help but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I still have one last song to sing...
All your kind words... I'm starting to tear up...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you for always being there...
Thank you for always singing with me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you... Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope we all get to spend more and more time together moving forward, and spreading that joy to as many people as we can!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all for joining us here today, and thanks to all those watching the stream!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Now, this is it! The final song!
Let's all have fun until the end!
